name: rulake-marketplace
description: ruLake — witness-anchored vector federation for agentic AI. Eight installable Claude Code plugins (one killer-path + seven composable) per ADR-009.

plugins.name: rulake-stack
plugins.description: Killer-path install: bundles rulake-core + rulake-substrates + rulake-witness with the deterministic retrieval path enabled and kernels off by default. The 90% case — one command gets retrieval working end-to-end.

plugins.name: rulake-core
plugins.description: The eight rulake_* MCP tools and the rulake_query decision layer plus /rulake-discover advisory tool. Wires to the live demo at https://rulake-mcp.ruv.io/ by default; switch to stdio for production.

plugins.name: rulake-memory
plugins.description: Self-learning, self-optimizing agentic memory. Wraps the witness-anchored ruLake cache as a working-memory surface — remember/recall/forget verbs, hit-ratio tuning, drift detection, audit-driven optimization. Memory that gets faster the more it's used.

plugins.name: rulake-rvdna
plugins.description: rvDNA — genomic substrate for ruLake. Adds the rvdna-mcp wire (5 tools: find, call_variants, translate, score, lineage) plus 5 slash commands. v0.0.1 ships witnessed stubs; the RaBitQ inner loop, variant index, and codon table land in v0.1.

plugins.name: rulake-ruqu
plugins.description: ruQu — quantum simulation substrate for ruLake. Adds the ruqu-mcp wire (5 tools: simulate, verify, replay, optimize, qec_schedule) plus 5 slash commands. Picks the right backend (StateVector / Stabilizer / TensorNetwork / Hardware-stub) per circuit.

plugins.name: rulake-kernels
plugins.description: ADR-157 accelerator plane: AVX-512 host SIMD and wgpu portable GPU. Off-by-default; operator opt-in. Includes /rulake-kernel-status and /rulake-kernel-bench commands.

plugins.name: rulake-witness
plugins.description: SHAKE-256(32) bundle verification and witness viewer CLI. /rulake-verify and /rulake-bundle-info commands.

plugins.name: rulake-loop-vector
plugins.description: /loop-aware vector workers — incremental indexing from a backend, refresh-from-bundle on schedule, witness-mismatch refuse-and-replan. The agentic-flow integration.
